prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, fully transparent PNG outside frame. Wonky skewed rounded quadrilateral border — NOT a straight rectangle: left edge nearly vertical, top edge slopes down 6 degrees left-to-right for forward energy, right edge tapers inward, bottom slopes up left-to-right, all corners heavily rounded. Border stroke coral orange #FF8A65, 5px solid, transparent interior. Lineless Corporate Memphis style, no black outlines, flat fills, minimal vest fold shade. Young man, SHS-college, light olive skin, short neat black hair, confident minimal dot eyes and half-smile. White collared shirt, coral #FF8A65 vest with golden #FFD54F tiny upward-arrow lapel pin, dark trousers, dark shoes. Full body standing open posture, compact megaphone in one hand, other hand gesturing up toward floating golden upward arrow and simple three-bar chart icon with no numbers or text. Figure off-center right inside frame. Confident visionary pitch energy. NO text, NO letters, NO background — transparent outside coral border.
